assumptions.warning: These assumptions are hypotheses for transfer equivalence only; they are not a structural validation.

items.statement: Section and material properties used by the analysis are those of the analysis program database, selected by the section and material names of the verified mapping rows. Declared limitation: database editions and material values may differ from the usual ones; they are compared against the catalogue and against the expected values with their cited source.
The arm-to-column connection is continuous: no member end is released. Declared limitation: the real connection is semi-rigid.

No rigid offsets: each analytical arm runs from the column axis to its tip and includes half the column and the plate. Declared limitation: the arm flexibility is overestimated, and no conclusion about real behaviour is drawn from V1.

A single load case REF1 carries the loads of the load file; there is no self weight and there are no combinations. Declared limitation: the loads are not derived from pallets, impact, seismic action or tributary areas.
COL.FOOT is fixed in its six degrees of freedom. Declared limitation: no anchor, base plate or slab stiffness is represented.
The base is not modelled; the idealisation starts at the column foot. Declared limitation: the real base bears on the floor.
Plane analysis: every node other than the foot restrains translation along X and rotation about Y and Z. Declared limitation: no out-of-plane buckling and no bracing effect are represented.

exclusions: The base, the plates, the gussets, the spacers, the bracing and the round bars are not modelled as elements (SUP-02, IDL-06, CD-I65-F1-14).
No self weight, no load combinations, no nodal loads, no distributed loads and no local loads.
No springs, no rigid end offsets and no releases (D-02, D-09).
